title: Grocery · Service detail
description: One service: HTTP RED by route, JVM, HikariCP, Kafka consumers, logs (Loki) and recent traces (Tempo).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service, le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{service="$service", instance=~"$instance", service!="api-gateway", uri!~".*/stream|.*/chat"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service, le) (rate(spring_cloud_gateway_requests_seconds_bucket{service="$service", instance=~"$instance", routeId!~".*stream.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by (method, uri, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{service="$service", instance=~"$instance", status=~"[45].."}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{service="$service", instance=~"$instance", uri!~".*/stream|.*/chat"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{service="$service", instance=~"$instance", uri!~".*/stream|.*/chat"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{service="$service", instance=~"$instance", uri!~".*/stream|.*/chat"}[$__rate_interval]))

targets.expr: sum by (spring_kafka_listener_id, error) (rate(spring_kafka_listener_seconds_count{service="$service", instance=~"$instance", error!~"none|"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (name, exception) (rate(spring_kafka_listener_seconds_count{service="$service", instance=~"$instance", result="failure"}[$__rate_interval]))
